t: A free Linux system for school computers from the Catalan education department.
steps: Find the Linkat project site from the Catalan education department.
Read the page in Catalan or use a translation tool.
Download the image. The fetched page text did not list downloads. Check the site.
Ask IT to test the install on one computer.
Pick the variant that matches the grade level.
Install it on a set of school computers.
Open the bundled applications and note which ones fit your lessons.
